# 1. Setup

This notebook performs initial QC and exploratory analysis for bulk RNA-seq data.

```{r load-packages}
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```

# 2. Load data

```{r load-data}
count_data <- read.delim("data/E-GEOD-52194-raw-counts.tsv",
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE)

count_data %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)
```

# 3. Load sample metadata

```{r load-metadata}
sample_metadata <- read.delim("data/E-GEOD-52194-experiment-design.tsv",
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                              check.names = FALSE)

sample_metadata %>%
  slice_head(n = 6)
```

# 4. Create sample information

```{r sample-info}
sample_info <- sample_metadata %>%
  select(
    sample_id = Run,
    clinical_info = `Sample Characteristic[clinical information]`,
    disease = `Sample Characteristic[disease]`,
    individual = `Sample Characteristic[individual]`,
    sex = `Sample Characteristic[sex]`,
    analysed = Analysed
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    clinical_info = factor(clinical_info),
    disease = factor(disease),
    sex = factor(sex),
    analysed = factor(analysed)
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

sample_info
```

```{r sample-info-upd}
# remove not analysed sample 
sample_info <- sample_info[sample_info$analysed == 'Yes', ]

# reorder 
sample_info <- sample_info[match(colnames(count_mat), rownames(sample_info)), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(sample_info), colnames(count_mat)))

# create column group
sample_info <- sample_info %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      clinical_info == "non-triple-negative breast cancer" ~ "non_triple_neg",
      clinical_info == "HER2 Positive Breast Carcinoma" ~ "her2_pos",
      clinical_info == "triple-negative breast cancer" ~ "triple_neg",
      clinical_info == "normal" ~ "normal",
      TRUE ~ clinical_info
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("normal", "triple_neg", "non_triple_neg", "her2_pos"))
  )

sample_info

```

# 5. Metadata summary

```{r metadata-summary}
summary(sample_info)

sample_info %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  count(clinical_info, name = "n_samples") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples))
```

# 6. Data inspection

```{r counts-matrix}
count_mat <- as.matrix(count_data[, -(1:2)])
rownames(count_mat) <- count_data$`Gene ID`

# inspect dimensions and a few rows
cat("Count matrix dimensions:", dim(count_mat), "\n")
head(count_mat[, 1:6])
```

# 5. Summarise library sizes

```{r library-sizes}
library_sizes <- colSums(count_mat)
summary(library_sizes)

library_size_df <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(library_sizes),
  total_counts = library_sizes
)

ggplot(library_size_df, aes(x = sample_id, y = total_counts)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Total counts per sample",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Total counts")
```

# 6. Create DESeq2 dataset

```{r deseq-dataset}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ group
)

dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 1, ]
dds
```

# 7. Transformations and exploratory plots

```{r vst-transformation}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

plotCounts(dds, gene = rownames(dds)[1], intgroup = "group")
```

# 8. PCA plot coloured by group

```{r pca-plot}
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "group") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "PCA of VST-transformed counts",
       color = "Group")
```

# 9. Sample distance heatmap

```{r sample-distance-heatmap}
sample_dists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))
sample_dist_mat <- as.matrix(sample_dists)
rownames(sample_dist_mat) <- colnames(sample_dist_mat) <- colnames(vsd)

pheatmap(sample_dist_mat,
         clustering_distance_rows = sample_dists,
         clustering_distance_cols = sample_dists,
         main = "Sample distance heatmap",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50))
```
